name: Simon's Cat
description: Simon's cat follows the silent-movie-like adventures of a cat and his owner and lots of others.

videos.title: Thank You 1 Million Subscribers!
videos.overview:
Today Simon's Cat reached 1million subscribers on YouTube!  When Simon's Cat first appeared on YouTube around four years ago we thought it was amazing to have just 100 subscribers. And today we still think it's wonderful to have any amount of people, small or large, appreciating what we do. While we make films that we like to watch, we also try to make films you enjoy too. And it is the massive support you all have shown that has given us the inspiration and ability to continue making more films.  We can't express enough how grateful we are for your patience, your feedback, your stories, your photos, your suggestions and your continued support.  Thank You,

Simon and the Simon's Cat team.

videos.title: Simon's Cat in Gromit Unleashed
videos.overview:
Simon's Cat creator Simon Tofield was honored to be invited to decorate a giant statue of Aardman's Gromit for their children's charity - The Grand Appeal (2013). All of the Gromit sculptures have been placed around the city of Bristol, UK. Visitors can search for statues on the The Gromit Unleashed Trail. They will then be auctioned later this year.

In this video, we see how Simon covered Gromit in 100s and 100s of his illustrations.

videos.title: Thank You 2 Million Subscribers!
videos.overview: Today Simon's Cat reached 2 million subscribers on YouTube! This is amazing considering it is less than a year since we reached 1 Million subscribers. When Simon's Cat first appeared on YouTube around five years ago we were proud to have 100 subscribers. We still think it's wonderful to have any amount of people, small or large, appreciating what we do. While we make films that we like to watch, we also try to make films you enjoy too. We can't express enough how grateful we are for your patience, your feedback, your stories, your photos, your suggestions and your continued support. We hope to continue bringing you fun filled cat antics for years to come! Thank You, Simon and the Simon's Cat team.
